subsystems.name: Command-and-control link
subsystems.role: the radio path between pilot or autonomy stack and the aircraft; if it can be hijacked, the aircraft can be stolen.

subsystems.name: Identity and trust anchor
subsystems.role: gives every drone and ground station a verifiable identity rather than a shared password.
parts: hardware secure element or trusted platform module

subsystems.name: Navigation integrity
subsystems.role: keeps position fixes trustworthy when satellite signals are jammed or spoofed.
parts: authenticated GNSS signals and signal-quality monitoring

subsystems.name: Onboard monitoring and response
subsystems.role: detects that something is wrong and puts the aircraft into a safe state.
parts: geofence and altitude limits enforced onboard

subsystems.name: Fleet network layer
subsystems.role: secures the mesh or swarm links and the broadcast identity other airspace users rely on.
parts: authenticated mesh routing and neighbour checks
air-to-ground gateway and ground control station

subsystems.name: Ground operations
subsystems.role: keeps the software, credentials and people behind the fleet under control.

buildSteps.title: Model the threats
buildSteps.detail: List what an attacker could do at each layer — jam the control link, spoof the position, take over the ground station, push malicious firmware — and rank them by impact: collision, hijack, or data theft.

buildSteps.title: Put a root of trust in the airframe
buildSteps.detail: Solder a secure element onto the flight-controller board and make the bootloader verify a signed firmware image before anything else runs, so modified software cannot start.

buildSteps.title: Stand up key management
buildSteps.detail: Issue a unique key pair and certificate per aircraft and per ground station from a certificate authority, record them in an inventory, and define how keys are rotated and revoked when an airframe is lost or sold.

buildSteps.title: Secure the links
buildSteps.detail: Turn on signing and encryption for command, telemetry and video; add nonces or sequence numbers so a recorded message cannot be replayed; where cellular is used, run the traffic inside a tunnel to the operator's own network.

buildSteps.title: Harden navigation
buildSteps.detail: Combine satellites from several constellations, monitor signal strength and consistency, and fuse inertial and visual measurements so a false position fix contradicts the other sensors and is rejected.

buildSteps.title: Add detection and safe-state logic
buildSteps.detail: Run lightweight anomaly checks on the flight controller for unexpected commands, sudden position jumps or link loss, and define exactly what the aircraft does in each case — hold, return, or land.

buildSteps.title: Make the fleet updateable
buildSteps.detail: Build a signed update pipeline so a patch can be pushed to hundreds of airframes and verified, because unpatched drones are the most common real vulnerability.

buildSteps.title: Operate and rehearse
buildSteps.detail: Log everything, monitor for attack indicators, run tabletop exercises and occasional red-team flights, and keep a procedure for grounding the fleet if a key is compromised.

prerequisites.why: flight controllers have little processing power and memory, so signatures and ciphers must be cheap.

prerequisites.tech: Hardware root of trust (secure elements, TPMs)
prerequisites.why: without a protected key store, an attacker who opens the airframe can simply copy the credentials.
encrypted or signed navigation signals exist on some constellations but are not yet universal or fully supported in low-cost receivers.
the tools exist in IT and automotive practice, but drone fleets rarely run them properly today.
broadcast identity lets authorities and other aircraft tell who is flying, and underpins enforcement.

pathway.milestone: signed telemetry links and broadcast remote identification on commercial fleets
pathway.unlocks: basic protection against casual command injection and a way to attribute flights.

pathway.milestone: zero-trust fleet identity with per-flight credentials and short-lived keys
pathway.unlocks: a stolen airframe or leaked password cannot be used to hijack a mission.

pathway.milestone: authenticated navigation fused with strong inertial backup
pathway.unlocks: safe flight through areas where jamming and spoofing are known to occur.

pathway.milestone: certified autonomy that detects compromise and recovers without a human
pathway.unlocks: routine beyond-visual-line-of-sight operations and dense drone logistics in shared airspace.
